channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mark Daigneault | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mark Daigneault from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cason Wallace on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Justin Martinez:Cason Wallace on if he has thought about the possibility of being a starter:

“It's not on the front of my mind, honestly.... Whenever (Mark Daigneault) puts me out there, I'm going to put my best foot forward.”

Cason Wallace on Mark Daigneault, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Al Horford on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Horford told The Oklahoman.

“I think that being there, learning and getting to understand how this NBA was going to go (was important).Coach Daigneault, this was kind of the vision he was seeing even then. And they started to implement it, so I was able to see it firsthand.”

Al Horford on Mark Daigneault, Jan 12, 2026. Source: The Oklahoman.

item.title: Aaron Wiggins on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Wiggins said of OKC's culture.

“It allows everybody to have that certain sense of trust from (Daigneault) and our coaching staff. He allows guys to go out there and play free. If you get going, it opens the game up for you as an individual and for our team. His trust and his confidence in the guys is huge for us.”

Aaron Wiggins on Mark Daigneault, Jun 18, 2025. Source: The Oklahoman.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“They have great coaching. That's obvious. Mark Daigneault is a guy I've had so much respect for over the last 5 years. Not just because of what they did last year and this year. But just how he's developed that roster and how they've developed their organizational philosophy. It's been a masterclass. Their schemes are super solid and they've got changeups they throw at you with trapping, zone and all kinds of things. Cross-matching. You know it. It's going to present some different challenges than we've seen.”

Rick Carlisle on Mark Daigneault, Jun 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Alex Caruso on being reunited with Mark Daigneault:

“I’d be lying if I told you I remembered a lot from when he coached me for the Blue other than that same kinda squinty eyed look that he gives when he’s thinking about stuff.”

Alex Caruso on Mark Daigneault, Oct 2, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Alex Caruso on Mark Daigneault:

“He still has the same personality and demeanor on the sideline when I was playing against him in the games as he did when I was with the Blue. Quiet, very observant... Just puts the players first. He's a good leader.”

Alex Caruso on Mark Daigneault, Jun 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Alex Caruso on being reunited with Mark Daigneault:

“Mark, I was smiling ear to ear talking to him on the phone.”

Alex Caruso on Mark Daigneault, Jun 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault's relationship with Alex Caruso:

“We're always talking. We talk all the time about the team. About things we value and things we feel like are on our plate... I think it's a great thing those guys have come full circle in their careers to get to this point.”

Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault, Alex Caruso, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Jalen Williams on Mark Daigneault’s transparency:

“We have a lot of straight shooters on our team so it helps when your coach is not beating around the bush… I think when you’re trying to avoid confrontation on things that can help guys get better, it slows down progress.”

Jalen Williams on Mark Daigneault, May 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault's relationship with the team:

“He's not that much older than us. He's one of the bros. There's still an extreme level of respect there professionally... We got great guys in the locker room who want to be better.”

Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault, Apr 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault winning COTY:

“Shoutout to Mark man. Helluva coach. He puts together some crazy X's and O's. Puts us all in position to be successful.”

Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault, Apr 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Jalen Williams on why Mark Daigneault should win COTY:

“He's coaching the second-youngest team in the NBA to the 1 seed... His biggest trait that serves us really well is being able to relate with us.”

Jalen Williams on Mark Daigneault, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault allowing him to play more free:

“Great coaches at the end of the day understand they’re not out there on the floor, so they give freedom to their players to go out there and make plays. Credit to Mark for doing that to us. He has a great level of trust in us”

Chet Holmgren on Mark Daigneault, Nov 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Mark Daigneault:

“He has a core belief system. And I 100% agree with it. I think he’s one heck of a coach.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Mark Daigneault, Apr 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Joe Mussatto:Presti on Daigneault:

“I think he did an excellent job... There was a significant amount of adjustments he had to make.”

Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault, May 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @joe_mussatto.

item.title: Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault
item.description:
Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault:

“As a basketball coach he's a great teacher. We couldn't be more excited about his acumen. We couldn't be more thrilled to re-welcome in in a different role.”

Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault, Nov 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.
